name: guru-benchmark
title_zh: 调用仓库内基准测试，不复制不改写
tagline_zh: Codex 里想跑基准测试，不用再翻文档找路径。这个 Skill 直接指向仓库里那份唯一权威的基准。
tagline_en: Run the repo's canonical benchmark from Codex without hunting paths or copying logic. Always points to the one.
desc_en: Use when invoking the repository-local Guru Benchmark from Codex or another Agent Skills client; delegates to the canonical skill without forking its behavior.
why_zh: 它不复制基准逻辑，只做委托——所有更新、修复都自动跟上原仓库，你的调用点永远不漂移。
why_en: It delegates instead of duplicating, so fixes and updates flow from the source—your invocation never drifts.
limit_zh: 只适用于仓库内已存在 guru-benchmark 基准的项目；若仓库没有该基准，此 Skill 会直接报错。
limit_en: Only works when the repo already contains the guru-benchmark target; otherwise it errors out—no auto-install or fallback.
title_en: Run the repo-local benchmark, no fork
